## Primary Cause
The primary cause of the revenue drop on day 2 (2025-03-11) compared to day 1 (2025-03-10) was a 15% discount applied to all orders on that day. This discount significantly reduced the net revenue per order.

## Dollar Impact
Comparing the two days:
- Day 1 (2025-03-10): Total net revenue was $8,499.91
- Day 2 (2025-03-11): Total net revenue was $4,455.45

The revenue drop on day 2 was $4,044.46 (approximately 47.7% of day 1's revenue).

## Recommendation
To mitigate the revenue impact of deep discounts, consider implementing a tiered discount system where:
1. The first 10% discount is applied to all orders
2. Additional discounts are only applied to orders exceeding a certain threshold
3. Premium products maintain their standard pricing

This approach would help maintain revenue while still offering attractive discounts to customers.
